project.name: MCP Gateway
project.description: Gateway that exposes model-context tools to internal applications.

issues.summary: Integrate MCP Gateway with Auth API v1
issues.content:
Issue: MCP-101
Summary: Integrate MCP Gateway with Auth API v1
Type: Story
Status: Done
Assignee: Mira Sen
Reporter: Dev Mehta
Labels: authentication, integration, production

Description:
MCP Gateway consumes Auth API v1 from Auth Service. The gateway sends credentials to POST /v1/auth before opening a tool session. Auth API v1 is a required production dependency.

issues.summary: Add retry policy around authentication calls
issues.content:
Issue: MCP-102
Summary: Add retry policy around authentication calls
Type: Task
Status: Done
Assignee: Mira Sen
Reporter: Dev Mehta
Labels: reliability, authentication

Description:
Retry transient failures from POST /v1/auth twice with exponential backoff. Do not retry rejected credentials. This behavior applies only to the MCP Gateway Auth API v1 client.
